title: Chronos-Atlas Docs System Design: Runtime Invariants and Algorithmic Bounds in Python
topic: Aether-Atlas Docs System Design: Real-Time Editing, OT, CRDT & Scale
author: Mateus Yonathan
journal: Polyglot Systems Lab Agentic Research Preprints

abstract: We present a lock-free hybrid of Operational Transformation (OT) and Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types (CRDT) for real-time collaborative editing in a Python-based Chronos-Atlas Docs System. The design preserves causal order using Lamport timestamps \cite{Lamport_1978_TimeClocks} and guarantees linearizability of local insert/delete operations via a rational-number identifier scheme. Static analysis of the implementation yields an amortized $O(1)$ complexity for local operations and $O(1)$ remote application under contention $O(P)$, where $P$ is the number of replicas. The source code is publicly available at \url{https://github.com/myonathanlinkedin/python-advanced-lab/tree/main/algorithms/20261028_190123_aether-atlas_docs_system_desig}.
